name: Darkmoon_Findings
author: ASC-IT, Darkmoon
description: Look up the vulnerabilities that a Darkmoon autonomous AI pentest campaign has already found on a URL, domain, FQDN or IP address. Read-only: it never launches a scan. Requires the Darkmoon Pro dashboard API.

configurationItems.name: url
configurationItems.description: Base URL of the Darkmoon dashboard API, with or without the /api/v1 suffix (e.g. https://darkmoon.example.org:8000)

configurationItems.name: token
configurationItems.description: Darkmoon API bearer token. Leave empty to log in with username and password instead

configurationItems.name: username
configurationItems.description: Darkmoon dashboard username, used only when no token is set

configurationItems.name: password
configurationItems.description: Darkmoon dashboard password, used only when no token is set

configurationItems.name: verify_ssl
configurationItems.description: Verify the TLS certificate of the Darkmoon API

configurationItems.name: min_severity
configurationItems.description: Only report findings at or above this severity: info, low, medium, high or critical

configurationItems.name: include_unconfirmed
configurationItems.description: Also report findings that the agents could not confirm or exploit (status unconfirmed)

configurationItems.name: max_findings
configurationItems.description: Maximum number of findings kept in the report (most severe first)
